Kageaki"I have no such intentionintention. Nevertheless, the rudeness was mine. My apologies."

en.html:
...I see.
From her side, yes. The account added up.

On the question of whether she had needed rescue, some doubt remained. Recalling her conduct at the time, I suspected she had possessed some means of surviving even a dragoon's attack.

Even so, a person acquainted with courtesy could hardly dismiss help as unnecessary without shame. Courtesy must be returned with courtesy. That sentiment, I understood. I nodded inwardly and bowed.

The woman and her elderly attendant exchanged glances and chuckled. This attitude of mine also amused them, perhaps.

She had saved the villagers from brutal soldiers.
From my standpoint, she <ruby>truly<rt>・・</rt></ruby> had <ruby>no reason at all<rt>・・・・・</rt></ruby> to thank me. But that was something she could not know.

Perhaps I should not have introduced myself as police in the first place. But my investigation in the village would have to proceed under the police's name. An unknown outsider could expect no cooperation.

Naturally, the lieutenant would hear of it.
To avoid needless suspicion later, I must identify myself now. Then, equally honestly, explain that I could not explain certain matters.

If this displeased her, there was no help for it.

Kanae"Even so, if my activity reaches headquarters I will probably be recalled at once. And if the magistrate comes back after that, the village returns to exactly how it was."
Kageaki"By the way, what about the magistrate's men?"
Sayo"Disarmed and confined. If we exterminated that lot, the magistrate would find things somewhat harder, of course."
Kanae"Execution is difficult unless they are caught in the act, Sayo. And if we send them to prison, they will be back after a one-night, two-day stay."

Kanae"The building where they are held burning down in an unfortunate fire? Considering that responsibility may land on the village, I wonder."
Sayo"If a meteorite falls from the sky, then really nothing can be done about it."
Kanae"Yes, true."

en.html:
Kanae"Anyway, leaving that aside. If the leader is crushed before things get complicated, everything will be settled neatly, Mr. Minato."
Kanae"You and I both want to catch the magistrate. Same purpose, so cooperation is natural, don't you think?"
Kageaki"One problem. Another magistrate may be posted and the same thing may happen again."
Kanae"Captain Nagasaka seems to have scattered his own pocket money around the Civil Affairs Section to have the mining business overlooked. If it were work ordered by the shogunate, he would have no need to do such a thing himself. So this is a solo run."
Sayo"I imagine he means to climb the promotion ladder with the profits of this enterprise as his weapon. Until it is on track he surely wants to keep the shogunate out. They would only take their cut."
Kageaki"Understood. For the village too, the best result is the magistrate gone and the mining stopped. May I take it that way without problem?"
ｅｔｃ／村長"Yes, yes! It is what we have been praying for. Please, please, I request you. Only..."
Kageaki"Yes?"
ｅｔｃ／村長"It is about the magistrate's men. At present not all of them are caught... maybe the rest have joined the magistrate."
Sayo"My. How careless. Did we miss some?"
ｅｔｃ／村長"I think the regular soldiers were all there. But as I said before, those suspicious fellows... the magistrate's bodyguards."
Kanae"Oh. Dear me, I forgot completely."
ｅｔｃ／村長"They seem to have gone off somewhere this morning. Devil's own luck, I should say... it seems that saved them from running into Madam Inspector."
Kageaki"Understood. I will keep it in mind."

　これより自分は任務を再開したく思います
が、行動の自由を認めて頂けるでしょうか」




香奈枝
「もちろんです。
　わたくしはしばらく、ここへご厄介になり
ます。支援が必要でしたらその都度、ご連絡
を下さいまし」




景明
「恐縮です。
　それでは失礼します。村長殿、お邪魔致し
ました」




ｅｔｃ／村長
「いえいえ！
　何のお構いもできませず……」
